_about: East-Asian (Japanese-origin) blood-type personality lore (血液型性格). Pop-culture entertainment, not science. Frame readings lightly.

A.light: Conscientious, patient, cooperative, detail-loving; the dependable one who remembers everyone's preferences.
A.shadow: Anxious, over-cautious, bottles up stress, quietly stubborn, fears rocking the boat.
A.in_love: Loyal and attentive, shows care through small thoughtful acts; needs reassurance and a partner who doesn't mistake their reserve for distance.

B.light: Curious, spontaneous, warm, marches to their own beat and pulls others into their enthusiasm.
B.shadow: Can seem self-absorbed, unpredictable, too blunt, loses interest fast.
B.in_love: Exciting and affectionate on their own terms; needs freedom and novelty, and a partner who doesn't try to cage them.

O.light: Warm, generous, goal-driven, the glue of the group; bounces back from setbacks.
O.shadow: Stubborn, blunt, competitive, likes the spotlight and being right.
O.in_love: Protective, devoted, and generous; wants to lead and provide, and needs to feel admired and trusted.

AB.light: Calm, fair, perceptive, sees many sides; an empathetic listener who rarely loses composure.
AB.shadow: Aloof, hard to read, indecisive, switches modes in ways that confuse people.
AB.in_love: Thoughtful and understanding, loves with the head as much as the heart; needs space and a partner who is patient with their reserve.

A-A.summary: Two careful, considerate souls — calm and harmonious, sharing values and routines.
A-A.watch: Both can be anxious and passive; nobody wants to rock the boat, so issues fester unspoken.

A-B.summary: Opposites that can balance: B loosens A up, A grounds B.
A-B.watch: A craves reliability; B craves freedom. Friction over plans, tidiness, and consistency.

A-O.summary: A classic steady pairing — O leads with warmth, A supports with care.
A-O.watch: O's bluntness can bruise A's sensitivity; A should speak up before resentment builds.

A-AB.summary: Quiet mutual understanding — AB reads A's reserve well and keeps things calm.
A-AB.watch: Both are private; without effort it can drift into politeness without intimacy.

B-B.summary: Lively, playful, never boring — two free spirits enjoying the ride.
B-B.watch: Two strong whims can collide; neither loves compromise or routine.

B-O.summary: High-energy and fun — O grounds B's chaos, B keeps O from taking itself too seriously.
B-O.watch: Both can be stubborn and blunt; clashes are loud but usually clear the air.

B-AB.summary: Creative and flexible — AB enjoys B's spark, both go with the flow.
B-AB.watch: B may read AB as cool or aloof; AB may find B's intensity tiring.

O-O.summary: Powerful and loyal — two warm leaders who'd go to bat for each other.
O-O.watch: Two captains, one ship: pride and a my-way streak need conscious give-and-take.

O-AB.summary: Often cited as a standout match — O's warmth and drive meet AB's calm and perspective.
O-AB.watch: O wants visible affection; AB shows it subtly. Name the love languages early.

AB-AB.summary: Deep, low-drama understanding — two composed minds that just get each other.
AB-AB.watch: Both reserved and a bit detached; someone has to actually voice the feelings.
